name: Herbie Active Task Supervisor watchdog
prompt: Script-only deterministic Herbie Active Task Supervisor watchdog. Sends transport-confirmed owner notifications only when task state requires attention; healthy/no-change runs are silent.
safety_notes: Do not activate before operator and independent review approval.
Before activation, set reviewed_commit to the exact approved commit and ensure workdir is a clean checkout at that commit.
Do not modify the existing private audit-request watcher job.
Do not modify the existing private transaction reconciliation monitor job.
Script-only no_agent mode: no LLM invocation on healthy intervals.
deliver=local prevents duplicate cron stdout delivery because this script uses its own transport-confirmed owner notification adapter.
